summary: 锂盐转换项目从机械完工到稳定商业产量期间，管理层常会逐次修订单条train的首产时间、产品等级、爬坡速度、年度产量和客户认证进度；若历史数据库只保留设计产能或最终实际产量，会丢失市场当时如何一轮轮推迟‘即将可用的电池级吨数’。
why_search_may_miss_it: 项目后来的演示通常覆盖旧进度，多个train与不同产品等级的指导值又分散在季度更新中，最终数据库容易只留下nameplate和最后达产状态。

recalled_details.gap_reason: the compact layer already contains Kwinana/Kemerton delay cases and expectation vintages, but does not explicitly preserve the sequence of converter ramp-guidance revisions as a dated project-level expectation trajectory
recalled_details.replay_link: would improve the Expectation side of 2019-2020 conversion supply by showing how much battery-grade chemical output market participants could reasonably count at each historical date rather than using hindsight nameplate or final output

suggested_queries: lithium hydroxide converter ramp guidance revision train first production qualification
锂盐 项目 爬坡 指引 修订 首产 电池级 认证
disconfirmation_queries: major lithium conversion projects reached original train-level timing and output guidance without material revisions

summary: 转换端的同期有效供给需要把到厂精矿/卤水原料、焙烧或浸出中间料、母液/返料、粗制品、提纯在制品、电池级成品库存和实际销售/交付串成物料平衡；流程停留时间和返工会使某月原料投放、会计产量与真正可交付锂盐跨期。
why_search_may_miss_it: 锂盐公司往往分别披露原料、产量和库存，工序内在制品与返料很少进入市场供给数据库，因此输入与成品交付容易被错误地放在同一时点。

recalled_details.gap_reason: CH-H003 already identifies mother-liquor/rework loops and CH-H006 separates inventory layers; this candidate refines them into one dated feed-to-delivery material-balance chain needed for point-in-time replay
recalled_details.replay_link: could reconcile temporary 2019-2020 divergences between concentrate availability, reported chemical production and battery-grade deliveries without inventing capacity changes

suggested_queries: lithium conversion work in process mother liquor inventory production sales reconciliation
锂盐 在制品 母液 返料 原料库存 成品库存 产销
disconfirmation_queries: lithium chemical feed input, reported production and customer delivery are contemporaneous with immaterial process inventory or rework

summary: 锂盐厂机械完工或首次产出并不等于形成稳定电池级供给；杂质控制、纯化/重结晶、批次一致性与客户认证可能使部分早期产量只能降级、返工或延后交付。
why_search_may_miss_it: 首次产品与设计产能更容易进入新闻标题，产品认证和早期不合格品往往只出现在运营说明。

recalled_details.gap_reason: the conversion-realization audit reactivated this mechanism, but CH-G002, CH-H005 and CHC-003 already materially resolve first-product-versus-stable-battery-grade qualification risk
recalled_details.replay_link: retained as a duplicate observation to measure novelty decay honestly rather than restating an existing effective-supply constraint as new

suggested_queries: lithium chemical battery grade qualification commissioning off spec ramp
锂盐 首产 电池级 认证 不合格 返工
disconfirmation_queries: first lithium chemical production is immediately equivalent to stable customer-qualified battery-grade output

summary: 锂盐转换产量可能由自有/权益原料、长期包销、外采现货或客户提供原料的代加工共同形成；这些模式决定原料与成品所有权、可自由销售吨数以及利润归属，不能把全部产量视为转换企业的merchant supply。
why_search_may_miss_it: 产量表通常不标原料和成品所有权，代加工与自营产量容易在行业汇总和企业销量间重复计量。

recalled_details.gap_reason: this ownership issue is already materially represented by CH-G006 and CH-H004, including feedstock mix and tolling versus self-operated conversion
recalled_details.replay_link: retained as a duplicate because rewriting captive/tolling/merchant ownership would falsely inflate novelty

suggested_queries: lithium conversion tolling captive feed merchant output ownership
锂盐 代加工 自有矿 包销 外采 产量 所有权
disconfirmation_queries: all lithium chemical production is converter-owned merchant supply regardless of feedstock arrangement

summary: 碳酸锂与氢氧化锂、工业级与电池级产品之间不能按价格无摩擦切换；原料路线、苛化/提纯工序、杂质与客户认证限制产品转换，因此锂盐总nameplate不能即时重分配为任意产品的有效供给。
why_search_may_miss_it: 总产能表会把不同产品和等级相加，掩盖实际工艺与认证边界。

recalled_details.gap_reason: CH-G001, CH-H001, CHC-002 and CHC-012 already cover product-grade taxonomy, carbonate/hydroxide route constraints and technical-to-battery upgrading
recalled_details.replay_link: retained as a duplicate so the bounded conversion probe records that this matrix gap is already substantially represented

suggested_queries: lithium carbonate hydroxide product swing capacity battery grade purification
碳酸锂 氢氧化锂 产能 切换 电池级 提纯 苛化
